scope: Linux x64 server and web, bundled TS/JS Definition and Implementation

finalPolicy.selectionRationale: All three bounded candidates (32 KiB, 64 KiB, 128 KiB) passed all acceptance budgets with zero unexpected errors, zero stale reveals, and complete zero-residual reap. 64 KiB (65536 bytes) is selected as the simplest evidence-supported baseline: matches Phase 01 proven spike constant, conservative text-size threshold, wire payload within 0.2% of 32 KiB across the 21-step fixed union (1,604,624 vs 1,601,075 bytes), and lowest small-tier navigation p95 latency (8.96 ms).

sampling.baseline: semantics OFF, same fixture and core/terminal schedule; repeat before each final comparison
sampling.navigation: alternate Definition and Implementation with deterministic unsaved edits and fixed pacing within rate policy
sampling.coreConcurrency: Barrier-started core and terminal schedule overlaps sustained navigation for every tier and repetition; record observed overlap and per-endpoint distributions.
sampling.adaptiveClient: Identical 21-step union for every compiled candidate: for each threshold T in 32768/65536/131072 bytes, T-1 ASCII, T-1 multibyte, T multibyte, T+1 multibyte, T+64 multibyte, T multibyte, T-1 ASCII. Real Chromium SemanticClient, authenticated gateway and packaged engine.
sampling.freshnessProbe: Actual Monaco Definition positive control, then edit source after a real server answer but before provider publication; observe no stale reveal.
sampling.pressure: Cached nontransactional actor diagnostics: transition-maintained per-session queue/in-flight/overlay high-water marks, lifetime launch/restart/outcome counters, completion-boundary concurrent samples, and post-reap residual accounting. Inspect directly held cold/warm/hostile actors; browser WS-created actor pressure explicitly unmeasured. Queue gauges exclude active processing/writes. No unexpected navigation errors/restarts or residual resources permitted.

budgets.coreAndTerminalP95Relative: loaded <= max(3 * baseline, baseline + 50ms), AND absolute budget

failurePolicy: retain failed aggregate; root-cause correction and a new versioned run record; never retroactively change workload/budget to pass
limitations: Portable sampled resource observations and V8 hints are not hard RSS or CPU ceilings.
No filesystem sandbox: trusted workspaces, server-account authority.
Hard mode requires actual delegated child-tree control evidence; unavailable mode remains unqualified.
No native, Windows, Android, Java or Rust qualification by analogy.
Actual built-web human visual acceptance remains Phase 10; Phase 09 G8 technical coexistence still requires real browser actions.
